story.text: 승객 여러분, 어느덧 충청 여정의 마지막 코스입니다. 이번엔 공주의 대표 먹거리로 여러분을 안내하겠습니다.
story.reading: seung-gaek yeo-reo-bun, eo-neu-deot chung-cheong yeo-jeong-ui ma-ji-mak ko-seu-im-ni-da.
story.en: Passengers, we've reached the final leg of our Chungcheong journey. This time I'll guide you to Gongju's signature food.

story.text: 공주 하면 떠오르는 것이 바로 '알밤'입니다. 크고 속이 꽉 찬 것이 특징이라, 예로부터 진상품으로도 유명했지요.
story.reading: gong-ju ha-myeon tteo-o-reu-neun geos-i ba-ro al-bam-im-ni-da.
story.en: What comes to mind with Gongju is the 'plump chestnut'. Known for being large and full, it was famous as a royal tribute item since long ago.

story.text: 가을이 되면 거리마다 '군밤' 냄새가 진동합니다. 따끈하게 구워낸 밤 하나가 겨울 초입의 정취를 더해주지요.
story.reading: ga-eul-i doe-myeon geo-ri-ma-da gun-bam naem-sae-ga jin-dong-ham-ni-da.
story.en: When autumn comes, the smell of 'roasted chestnuts' fills every street. A single warm roasted chestnut adds to the atmosphere of early winter.

story.text: 밤으로 빚은 술도 있습니다. 바로 '밤막걸리'인데, 은은한 단맛이 목 넘김을 부드럽게 해줍니다.
story.en: There's also a liquor brewed from chestnuts. It's called 'chestnut makgeolli', and its gentle sweetness makes it go down smoothly.

story.text: 이 밖에도 공주에는 다양한 '향토음식'이 있습니다. 지역의 재료로 오랜 세월 이어온 맛이지요.
story.reading: i bakk-e-do gong-ju-e-neun da-yang-han hyang-to-eum-sig-i it-seum-ni-da.
story.en: Besides this, Gongju has various 'local dishes' — flavors passed down over the years using regional ingredients.

story.text: 여행을 마치기 전, 공주의 '특산물'을 하나쯤 챙겨가시는 건 어떨까요? 알밤이야말로 최고의 선물이 될 겁니다.
story.reading: yeo-haeng-eul ma-chi-gi jeon, gong-ju-ui teuk-san-mul-eul ha-na-jjeum chaeng-gyeo-ga-si-neun geon eo-tteol-kka-yo?
story.en: Before finishing your trip, how about taking home one of Gongju's 'local specialties'? Plump chestnuts would make the best gift.

story.text: 달콤한 공주 이야기, 입맛 당기셨나요? 이제 시장에서 나눈 실제 대화를 읽고 상황을 맞혀보는 문제로 마무리해봅시다.
story.en: Did this sweet Gongju story whet your appetite? Let's wrap up with questions where you read a real market conversation and figure out the situation.

words.example_en: Plump chestnuts are big and sweet, Gongju's pride.
The smell of roasted chestnuts fills the street.
Chestnut makgeolli's gentle sweetness is exquisite.

words.example: 향토음식을 맛보는 것도 여행의 큰 즐거움입니다.
words.example_reading: hyang-to-eum-sig-eul mat-bo-neun geot-do yeo-haeng-ui keun jeul-geo-um-im-ni-da
words.example_en: Tasting local cuisine is also a great joy of traveling.
The market is crowded with people wanting to buy local specialties.

sentences.en: Plump chestnuts are big and sweet, Gongju's pride.
The smell of roasted chestnuts fills the street.
Chestnut makgeolli's gentle sweetness is exquisite.

sentences.ko: 향토음식을 맛보는 것도 여행의 큰 즐거움입니다.
sentences.reading: hyang-to-eum-sig-eul mat-bo-neun geot-do yeo-haeng-ui keun jeul-geo-um-im-ni-da
sentences.en: Tasting local cuisine is also a great joy of traveling.
The market is crowded with people wanting to buy local specialties.

turns.speaker: 손님
turns.text: 사장님, 알밤이 진짜 크네요. 이거 얼마예요?
turns.reading: sa-jang-nim, al-bam-i jin-jja keu-ne-yo. i-geo eol-ma-ye-yo?
turns.en: Wow, these chestnuts are really big. How much are they?

turns.speaker: 상인
turns.text: 한 되에 만 원인데, 공주 알밤이라 다른 데보다 알이 굵어요.
turns.reading: han doe-e man won-in-de, gong-ju al-bam-i-ra da-reun de-bo-da al-i gulg-eo-yo.
turns.en: It's 10,000 won a measure, but since they're Gongju chestnuts, they're plumper than elsewhere.

turns.speaker: 손님
turns.text: 그럼 두 되만 주세요. 선물용으로 포장도 되나요?
turns.reading: geu-reom du doe-man ju-se-yo. seon-mul-lyong-eu-ro po-jang-do doe-na-yo?
turns.en: I'll take two measures then. Can you gift-wrap it too?

turns.speaker: 상인
turns.en: Of course, I'll wrap it up nicely for you.

dialogues.question: 손님이 상인에게 부탁한 것은 무엇인가요?
dialogues.question_en: What did the customer ask the merchant to do?
dialogues.correct_answer: 알밤 두 되를 선물용으로 포장해 달라는 것
options: 알밤 두 되를 선물용으로 포장해 달라는 것
dialogues.explanation: 손님은 알밤 두 되를 사면서 '선물용으로 포장도 되나요?'라고 물었습니다.

turns.speaker: 친구1
turns.text: 공주 여행 어땠어? 뭐가 제일 기억에 남아?
turns.reading: gong-ju yeo-haeng eo-ttaess-eo? mwo-ga je-il gi-eog-e nam-a?
turns.en: How was your Gongju trip? What do you remember most?

turns.speaker: 친구2
turns.text: 밤막걸리! 처음엔 별 기대 안 했는데 진짜 부드럽고 맛있더라.
turns.reading: bam-mak-geol-li! cheo-eum-en byeol gi-dae an haet-neun-de jin-jja bu-deu-reop-go mas-it-deo-ra.
turns.en: The chestnut makgeolli! I didn't expect much at first, but it was really smooth and delicious.

turns.speaker: 친구1
turns.text: 나도 다음에 가면 꼭 마셔봐야겠다. 안주는 뭐 먹었어?
turns.reading: na-do da-eum-e ga-myeon kkok ma-syeo-bwa-ya-get-da. an-ju-neun mwo meog-eoss-eo?
turns.en: I should definitely try it next time I go. What did you eat with it?

turns.speaker: 친구2
turns.text: 향토음식 정식을 시켰는데, 반찬 하나하나가 다 정성스러웠어.
turns.reading: hyang-to-eum-sik jeong-sig-eul si-kyeoss-neun-de, ban-chan ha-na-ha-na-ga da jeong-seong-seu-reo-woss-eo.
turns.en: I ordered the local-cuisine set meal, and every single side dish was made with care.

dialogues.question: 친구2가 공주 여행에서 가장 기억에 남는다고 말한 것은 무엇인가요?
dialogues.question_en: What did Friend 2 say was the most memorable part of the Gongju trip?
dialogues.explanation: 친구2는 '밤막걸리! 처음엔 별 기대 안 했는데 진짜 부드럽고 맛있더라'라며 가장 기억에 남는다고 말했습니다.
